privacy.neroevents.optout.done: From now on NeroEvents stores no reward history under your player id. You are still paid: credits go to your account, items and XP go to a temporary reward crate that is cleared when the server restarts — claim them with /neroevents claim before then. Because nothing is stored, a server restart during an event could pay you twice or not at all for that event. Earlier rows keep your id until they expire (at most %1$s days) or you ask for erasure with /neroland data eraseme. Undo with /neroevents privacy optin.
privacy.neroevents.optout.done.solo: From now on NeroEvents stores no reward history under your player id. You are still paid: credits go to your account, items and XP go to a temporary reward crate that is cleared when you leave the world — claim them with /neroevents claim before then. Because nothing is stored, leaving the world during an event could pay you twice or not at all for that event. Earlier rows keep your id until they expire (at most %1$s days) or you ask for erasure with /neroland data eraseme. Undo with /neroevents privacy optin.
